newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Russel Metals ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Russel Metals ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday it confirmed the ratings of Russel Metals Inc with a stable trend.

DBRS said it confirmed the ratings on Russel's 10.2 percent debentures and 10.25 percent senior notes at BB, eight percent subordinated debentures and nine percent subordinated convertible debentures at BB(low) and series C C$30 million preferred shares at Pfd-4.
The bond rating service said that although Russel's financial profile weakened further in 1996, its profitability was expected to stabilize through 1997.

Factors contributing to the favorable outlook on earnings included a strengthening Ontario economy, the completion of the expanded dock facilities in Skagway, Alaska and the expansion of Russel's profitable international trading operations.
DBRS said recent write-offs removed the impact of under-performing assets on earnings, while higher operating cash flow should help stabilize Russel's balance sheet through 1997.
